From: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@auroralabs.com>

Cc: procurement@auroralabs.com
Date: Tue, 05 Jun 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot extension request — extra 6 weeks + packaging question

Hi Marcus,

Hope you’re well — quick ask from our side. We’re mid-way through the lab pilot and seeing good signal on intent-to-integrate, but the team needs another ~6 weeks to finish a set of integration tests and a small production-ish load test.

Two questions:
- Can Redwood extend the current timeboxed pilot by 6 weeks?
- If so, what packaging/pricing options do you recommend — a time-extension fee vs. a credit bucket we can draw from? We’re particularly sensitive to near-term budget vs. committing to a bigger prepay.

We’ve attached an updated SOW with the extra acceptance criteria and proposed dates. Also, we may need a short one-week engineering surge during the heavy load test window; is that something you can accommodate?

Thanks — can also jump on a 30-min call this Thursday if easier.

Best,
Aisha Khan
Director, Platform Engineering
Aurora Labs

Attachment: Aurora_POC_SOW_v1.pdf (application/pdf, 240KB)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Khan <aisha.khan@auroralabs.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 06 Jun 2028 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot extension request — extra 6 weeks + packaging question

Aisha — thanks for the note and for sending the SOW. Quick reaction and two pragmatic paths so you can pick what fits Aurora best: 

Option A — Timebox extension (simpler)
- 6-week addendum to existing pilot, flat fee: $28,000 (covers reserved capacity and priority scheduling for the new acceptance tests).
- Includes one (1) week of engineering surge (up to 40 hours) at no extra charge.
- Billing: invoice on execution, net 30.

Option B — Credit bucket (flexible)
- $22,000 credit bucket to draw against inference units and eng hours; any overage billed at standard rates.
- Credits expire 60 days from purchase.
- If you choose this path we can also set an automatic 15% rollover credit at conversion to a committed plan if Aurora converts within 90 days.

Approvals & discounting: I can approve up to a 10% discretionary discount on either option. Any discount >10% will need Finance/RevOps sign-off (or an exception from leadership).

If you want, I can prepare an addendum today (term-sheet attached) and send to your procurement. Happy to take a 20–30 min call Thursday to align on the engineering window and acceptance criteria.

Would love to know which of A or B you prefer by EOD Thursday so we can lock scheduling.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Kimberly / Laura — forwarding Aurora’s ask. They’re asking for a 6-week extension + a potential one-week eng surge. I proposed two paths: $28k flat timebox (with 1 week surge included) or $22k credit bucket (60-day expiry, with conversion incentive).

I can approve up to 10% discount. They’re pushing on minimizing cash outlay today — likely to prefer the credit bucket. I’d like approval to:
- Offer 10% off Option B ($22k -> $19,800) without further review.
- If possible, allow a one-time 15% discount if we fast-track a conversion incentive (i.e., sign a 12-month committed plan within 90 days).

Risks/asks: engineering surge is modest but we need to confirm capacity scheduling; billing net30 is fine. If 15% is allowed, I’ll need QA that Finance is okay with the revenue recognition/commission treatment.

Thanks — can you reply with quick yes/no on the 10% and whether 15% needs exec? I can loop Revenue Ops if helpful.

—Marcus

Marcus — quick answers:
- Approve up to 10% discretionary on either option. Please record the rationale (deal velocity + strategic fit).
- 15% requires RevOps & Sales Leadership approval. If Marcus can present the conversion trigger (12-month committed ARR target + timeline), RevOps will evaluate impact on quotas/recognition.
- Legal: we should not change SLA language in the SOW; any change to uptime/SLOs needs Legal sign-off and likely a 30-day transition. So we can include the 1-week engineering surge as operational support only (not an SLA commitment).

Laura — please confirm Finance okay with net30 for a $20k-ish add-on. If not, suggest short-term escrow or milestone invoicing.

K
